acceptanceCriteria: Under a 10240 descriptor limit on darwin, TestCALV0026_AuditInventoryParityAndFallback and TestCALV0026_GuardedInventoryPopulated5000 pass.

WatchChanges never fails for store size alone; files beyond a bounded descriptor budget are still checked for content writes, mode changes, replacement and removal, proven by a maintained darwin test that forces a tiny budget.
Stores within the budget keep the existing kqueue behavior, and the agent-leases spec states the budget and the fallback's limit.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64 and GitHub macos-15, 2026-10-05, release candidate da78c1572211a85e6c9944adb98350d69964eb9b (1.0.0-rc.2 candidate 2). authority.WatchChanges on darwin (internal/tasks/authority/change_guard_darwin.go) opens one O_EVTONLY descriptor per watched directory and regular file under the state directory and intent tree and holds them until Close. Go raises the soft RLIMIT_NOFILE only to min(hard, kern.maxfilesperproc), 10240 on the hosted runner. Expected: lease reads, lease preparation and recovery work on a store within the wire bounds. Actual: WatchChanges returns `too many open files`; readLeaseProof, prepareLease and prepareLeaseRecovery fail (Mutate already degrades). Reproduction: `(ulimit -Hn 10240; ulimit -Sn 10240; GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 -run 'TestCALV0026_(AuditInventoryParityAndFallback|GuardedInventoryPopulated5000)' ./internal/tasks/store)` fails at audit_inventory_test.go:96 and guarded_inventory_test.go:671; passes at 24576. Hosted evidence: release-gates run 37381427566 job 112004121660. The darwin guard is new since v1.0.0-rc.1, so this is an rc.2 regression.

completion.reason: Descriptor-budget stat fallback landed in 'rc.2: fix darwin descriptor exhaustion' (candidate 3) with maintained darwin tiny-budget tests; agent-leases spec states the budget (line 1403 at b7b21205). The remaining lock-hold refinement is V1-0845. Hosted Release gates run 37466658604 on b7b21205 (published as v1.0.0-rc.2) passed full-gate on macos-15 and ubuntu-24.04 (make gate incl. cross-vet and go-test), and the local make gate passed on darwin/arm64 with the default symlinked TMPDIR; the SRR-V1 readiness record (sha256 above, corvint-release-evidence/1.0.0-rc.2-b7b21205) was built and verified.

title: Darwin Tasks change guard exhausts descriptors on a 5000-receipt store (too many open files)
